title: The Pencil Shavings Monsoon
description: On the last day of school, the art teachers bring baskets to the courtyard. The storm leaves cedar curls in every color they used that year.
alt: Art teachers hold woven baskets on school steps as brightly edged pencil shavings swirl beneath violet clouds beside a giant orange pencil.
pairing: An imagined last-day-of-school festival × a rainstorm of colored pencil shavings
